notes.page_content: Continuation headed Dém. par récurrence. The text gives cardinality cases, the written U expressions and three braced conditions, then names K1 in the lower prose and ends with another complement-of-union expression. These statements are transcribed; no proof check is claimed.
notes.paragraph_order: Opening proof prose, paired display, following prose, recurrence lead-in and equality, où and brace, On a donc and display, lower paragraph and final display.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: The mathematical expressions identified the local targets: large join glyphs, predecessor indices, hats, lower limits and noninclusion strokes. No expected identity, theorem, grammatical repair or mathematical correction was used to settle an unreadable mark.

S_row_handling.status: locally inspected as a witness proposal only
S_row_handling.result: The three quoted examples in the supplied broad-range row do not occur verbatim on this page. The visible raised signs at this page’s nine hatted Sigma occurrences are angular roofs already represented in current C/H. No new closure bar is inferred.

notes.H_apparatus: H’s two note macros concerning neighboring sheets and its page label are apparatus. No prose is invented from them, and no H collation count is assigned merely for their omission.
notes.image_order: Whole once, a once, b once; then crop01 through crop16 once each. All deliveries succeeded. No image was reopened.
notes.image_processing: PIL crop, autocontrast, LANCZOS resize to width 2800 and UnsharpMask only. No OCR or recognition, no source pixel matching, no image difference calculation, no optional geometry calculation.
notes.coordinate_maps: Full scan 1692x2362; each half 1692x1261. a uses y_full=y_a; b uses y_full=y_b+1101, with 1101=2362-1261. Crop boxes all use the original full scan upper-left origin.
notes.graphical_representation: M01, M03 and M04 use fixed local rectangles and literal paths/fills with their full-scan origins written in the TeX comments. M02 and M05 use qualified dot candidates. These preserve observed shapes without assigning a character role, mathematical operation, hand or surface origin. Font extents and surrounding TeX placement are manual approximations, not rendered or metrically validated.
notes.crop_boundaries: Crop01 and crop15 include the physical right/bottom paper boundaries. Crop13 contains the entire target K1/cet/ens./donc group; its upper boundary cuts only the preceding line’s long descender. Crop16 contains the whole isolated pale trace but no adjacent text line. No repeat crop was made.
notes.validation: Only structural source checks are authorized: braces, delimiters, environments, macro names, file references and reading/report consistency. No compilation, rendering or installation is performed.
notes.source_validation_history: The first source-only pass treated comment-only lines as blank paragraphs. The validator was corrected to inspect actual physical blank lines in the unstripped source. The required repeated source-only pass returned no errors; the TeX source did not need a blank-line repair.
